target.output: append-only worker lifecycle census receipts plus deterministic cohort compiler
target.scope: instrumented /wc worker sessions and explicit stress cohorts

canonical_identity.problem: Current durable claim/run/return evidence can reconstruct workers that acquired or executed work, but cannot reconstruct the denominator of launched compatible workers or prove when a worker validly became IDLE_NO_SAFE_WORK. The 50-worker stress verifier therefore leaves global idle ratio UNKNOWN; silence or chat disappearance cannot safely be treated as idle.
acceptance: Each instrumented worker invocation has a stable worker_session_id and append-only lifecycle receipts linking bootstrap, frontier scans, claim attempts, STARTED, RETURNED, reallocation and terminal boundary states.
IDLE_NO_SAFE_WORK is valid only with a durable receipt proving the active normal queues plus portfolio fallback were scanned and no compatible safe work remained; silence is never idle evidence.
A vanished or interrupted worker remains UNKNOWN/DISAPPEARED unless an explicit terminal receipt exists.
Claims, runs, returns and reallocation cycles can be joined to one session without rewriting immutable artifacts.
Duplicate/replayed lifecycle receipts deduplicate deterministically and cannot inflate launched, active or idle counts.

A 5-worker and a 50-worker fixture/canary make launched/active/idle/boundary counts and global idle ratio computable for the instrumented cohort while legacy/uninstrumented coverage remains explicit UNKNOWN/PARTIAL.
Receipts contain coordination metadata only, never raw prompt/transcript/private content, and they confer no authority or production /w promotion.

dedup_note: Distinct from claim-attempt receipt hardening, recovery writer fencing and portfolio exclusive-pin repair: those prove ownership/collision outcomes after allocation. This pin targets the missing canonical worker-session denominator and explicit IDLE/vanish lifecycle needed for global idle/utilization metrics and safe saturation evidence.
